newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Singapore's Pidemco Land allots US$120 mln FRN.
newsitem.headline: Singapore's Pidemco Land allots US$120 mln FRN.

text.p: Pidemco Land's US$120 million floating rate note issue has been allotted, arranger Standard Chartered Bank Singapore said.
The facility has a final maturity of five years. It was priced at par to float at 26 basis points over the six-month London Interbank Offered Rate.
With fees, the all-in return for top-tier managers is 28 basis points.
Arrangers with US$15 million each are Standard Chartered Bank Singapore, Credit Lyonnais Singapore, DKB Merchant Bank Singapore, LTCB Asia, Merrill Lynch Far East and Sakura Merchant Bank Singapore.
Co-lead manager Tokai Asia committed US$10 millon.
Other co-lead managers with US$5 million each are Daiwa Merchant Bank Singapore, Daiwa Securities Singapore, NordLB and Nomura Singapore.
